pages.text: A farmer set out a little paper of flakes among the seed. They had sifted them from the rows after the ground went quiet. I paid two emeralds and left the rest for the village.
pages.title: A Quiet Market
A Quiet Market
pages.text: Apprentice farmers in the liberated Overworld keep a small supply of dormant flakes. Look for the exchange when they open their stalls. It returns with their ordinary stock.
